name: Ubukata Ranko
source:
[url=/c1080]Ibuki[/url]'s personal tennis coach.
She once was a legendary professional tennis player. At that time she were called "Queen of the Far East". Now they call her "The Uncrowned Queen", but she never wanted to have any of those titles in the first place.

Her tennis tactics are refreshing and smart, but many fans said that in the latest games she wasn't all that good. Due to that she had retired from tennis, then she has been recognized as a retired coach after accepting Ibuki as her trainee. However, even after receiving the title of an "adviser" (or coach), she still wants to resume her tennis career someday.

Hobbies: Tennis
Favourite Food: Cheese fondue

[Translated from [url=http://www.purplesoftware.jp/products/akiiro/chara.html]Akiiro Renka's official website[/url].]
